column1: # Mutants for the add-tile result mapping (TileAddOutcome.kt).
#   scripts/mutate.sh batch scripts/mutants/tile-add.tsv
# 🔴 DEFINITIONS ONLY — no verdicts. A results table is void the moment the
# tree moves; results go in the PR body stamped with the commit.
# Every row changes ONE enum value or ONE resource id and leaves the `when`
# structure intact, so a kill is attributable to that expression alone. None of
# them removes a branch or touches an enclosing condition.
# The FILTER column is deliberately NOT the same for every row, and that is the
# measurement rather than an optimisation:
#   m1/m2 are filtered to TileAddDeclinedTest ALONE — the regression test, the
#   one watched to fail on f54ea19. They re-create the original defect (a
#   declined prompt reported as added) by two different narrowest edits: one in
#   the code->outcome map, one in the outcome->string map. If either SURVIVES
#   that filter, the regression test is decorative and the fix is pinned only
#   by the new-code guard, which cannot be red on pre-change code.
#   m3/m4 are filtered to TileAddPromptTest, which is where the
#   already-added and unknown-code arms are pinned.
m1-declined-maps-to-added
m2-declined-shows-added-string
m3-already-added-shows-added-string
m4-unknown-code-treated-as-added
